settings.title: Clear Communication. Stronger Health Outcomes Across Africa.

settings.editor: From clinical research documentation to laboratory materials and patient communications, SawaTech helps life sciences and healthcare organizations deliver accurate, culturally appropriate multilingual content across African and Middle Eastern markets.

settings.title: Specialized Language Support for Life Sciences

settings.editor: Supporting organizations that need precise, consistent and locally relevant communication throughout research, healthcare delivery and market expansion.

settings.description_text: Protocols, informed consent forms, clinical trial documents, case report forms and patient-facing study materials.
Laboratory documentation, SOPs, research reports, training content and healthcare communications.
Instructions for use, device manuals, labeling, software interfaces and technical documentation.
Patient education, outreach materials, multilingual training and culturally adapted health information.

settings.editor:
For a leading global healthcare organization, SawaTech coordinated a team of Swahili language specialists through a centralized memoQ workflow, shared terminology resources, and structured translation, editing and proofreading processes.

The result: consistent terminology and large-scale clinical content delivery within a demanding schedule.

settings.description_text: Native-speaking linguists with strong African and Middle Eastern language capabilities.
Experienced resources for technical, clinical and healthcare-related content.
Quality-oriented workflows certified to ISO 17100, ISO 9001 and ISO 18587.
Terminology management, translation memories, QA and appropriately governed technology-assisted processes.

settings.editor: Language-services certifications. They do not constitute clinical, laboratory or regulatory accreditation.
